title: DGE Shasthrarangam 2021–22 online/digital activity directions, 12 July 2021, public mirror

evidence_locators.scope: 12 July header; Covid-related online/digital decision; school through state directions; project and home-experiment provisions.
Remaining activity types, distinct project/non-project schedules, inauguration target and forwarding/access directions.
Level descriptions with different school/subdistrict dates, online conduct, academic/technical support and school/subdistrict duties.
District/state committees, headteachers/principals, AEO/DDE and DIET duties; handwritten signature labelled Director of General Education and circulation.

date_anomalies: Discovery index labels the link 10 July 2021; actual circular is 12 July 2021.
PDF2 explicitly gives non-project activities: school 30 August, subdistrict 20 September, district 30 September; projects: school 25 September, subdistrict 10 October, district 25 October.
PDF3 level descriptions have no explicit item heading and say school completion on 25 August, subdistrict on 15 September and district before 30 September. No single harmonised timetable is inferred.
provenance_limit: Public Drive copy discovered through a teacher index. Handwritten signature is labelled Director of General Education; no personal signatory name or authenticated signature is inferred. No original-hosted copy recovered.
review_scope: All four pages rendered and read visually. Legacy-font extraction is damaged and was used only as a discovery aid.
notes: Directs online/digital Shasthrarangam activities because of Covid. Seven numbered activity types include projects, home experiments and mathematical concept presentations. Dated plans, selection/support duties and historical participation conditions do not prove completion or supply Science Working Model rules, a Sasthrolsavam resumption, or current cloud permission.
